name: Reactive Resume
description: Free and open source resume builder with real-time preview and multiple templates.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://reactive_resume:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/reactive_resume"
      REDIS_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      PUBLIC_URL: "http://localhost:8134"
      STORAGE_URL: "http://localhost:8134/api/storage"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET: {{env.ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET}}
      REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET: {{env.REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/app/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: reactive_resume
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: reactive_resume
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
